sentences.text: It is stated that as per the award, the compensation amount was around Rs.2,31,00,000/-, but the respondents deposited a sum of Rs.2,13,00,000/- only.
Regarding possession, it is contended that the retail outlet is still being run by the petitioners at the site.

On this premise, it is contended that the subject-acquisition is liable to lapse under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. In order to ascertain the correct facts, let notice be issued, returnable on 06.01.2025.
3. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Visen, AOR accepts notice on behalf of respondent no.4.
4. Other respondents be served through usual mode as we as through dasti service.
5. The respondents may take over possession of the acquired property without prejudice to the petitioners claim for compensation under the new Act.

(ARJUN BISHT) (PREETHI T.C.)
